words.meaningEn: a greeting used when meeting someone
words.meaningVi: lời chào khi gặp ai đó
words.exampleSentence: She said hello to her neighbor.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy chào người hàng xóm.
words.usageContext: Informal and formal greeting, used in speech and writing.

words.meaningEn: used to make a polite request
words.exampleSentence: Could you please pass the salt?
words.exampleVi: Bạn làm ơn đưa giúp tôi lọ muối được không?
words.usageContext: Polite request, commonly used in daily conversation.

words.meaningEn: feeling regret or penitence
words.exampleSentence: I am sorry for being late.
words.exampleVi: Tôi xin lỗi vì đến muộn.
words.usageContext: Used to apologize or express sympathy.

words.meaningEn: an expression of gratitude
words.exampleSentence: Thanks for your help.
words.exampleVi: Cảm ơn vì sự giúp đỡ của bạn.

words.meaningEn: used to express good wishes when parting or at the end of a conversation
words.exampleSentence: He waved goodbye and left.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy vẫy tay tạm biệt và rời đi.

words.meaningEn: used to give an affirmative response
words.exampleSentence: Yes, I would love to come.
words.exampleVi: Vâng, tôi rất muốn đến.

words.meaningEn: used to give a negative response
words.exampleSentence: No, I don’t want any more tea.
words.exampleVi: Không, tôi không muốn thêm trà.

words.meaningEn: perhaps; possibly
words.exampleSentence: Maybe we will go to the beach tomorrow.
words.exampleVi: Có lẽ ngày mai chúng ta sẽ đi biển.

words.meaningEn: make it easier for someone to do something
words.exampleSentence: Can you help me with this box?
words.exampleVi: Bạn có thể giúp tôi với cái hộp này không?
words.usageContext: Used when offering or asking for assistance.

words.meaningEn: a person whom one knows and with whom one has a bond of mutual affection
words.exampleSentence: She is my best friend.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy là bạn thân nhất của tôi.
words.usageContext: Used to refer to someone you know well and like.

words.meaningEn: a group of one or more parents and their children living together as a unit
words.exampleSentence: My family lives in New York.
words.exampleVi: Gia đình tôi sống ở New York.

words.meaningEn: a colorless, transparent, odorless liquid
words.exampleSentence: Can I have a glass of water?
words.exampleVi: Cho tôi một ly nước được không?

words.meaningEn: any nutritious substance that people or animals eat or drink
words.exampleSentence: We need to buy some food for dinner.
words.exampleVi: Chúng ta cần mua một ít thức ăn cho bữa tối.

words.meaningEn: the indefinite continued progress of existence and events
words.exampleSentence: What time is it?
words.exampleVi: Bây giờ là mấy giờ?
words.usageContext: Used to ask about or state the hour.

words.meaningEn: a period of twenty-four hours
words.exampleSentence: It is a beautiful day.
words.exampleVi: Hôm nay là một ngày đẹp trời.
words.usageContext: Refers to the 24-hour period or daylight hours.

words.meaningEn: the period of darkness in each twenty-four hours
words.exampleSentence: The stars are bright tonight.
words.exampleVi: Đêm nay những vì sao rất sáng.
words.usageContext: Refers to the time after sunset.

words.meaningEn: the period of time between midnight and noon
words.exampleSentence: Good morning, how did you sleep?
words.exampleVi: Chào buổi sáng, bạn ngủ ngon không?
words.usageContext: Greeting or referring to early day.

words.meaningEn: on or in the course of this present day
words.exampleSentence: I have a lot of work to do today.
words.exampleVi: Hôm nay tôi có rất nhiều việc phải làm.

words.meaningEn: a word or set of words by which a person, animal, place, or thing is known
words.exampleSentence: My name is John.
words.exampleVi: Tên tôi là John.
words.usageContext: Used to introduce oneself or ask who someone is.

words.meaningEn: activity involving mental or physical effort done in order to achieve a purpose or result
words.exampleSentence: I have to go to work now.
words.exampleVi: Bây giờ tôi phải đi làm.

words.meaningEn: under normal conditions; generally
words.exampleSentence: I usually wake up at 7 AM.
words.exampleVi: Tôi thường thức dậy lúc 7 giờ sáng.

words.meaningEn: occasionally, rather than all of the time
words.exampleSentence: Sometimes I like to stay home and read.
words.exampleVi: Thỉnh thoảng tôi thích ở nhà và đọc sách.

words.meaningEn: at all times; on all occasions
words.exampleSentence: She always arrives on time.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy luôn đến đúng giờ.

words.meaningEn: at no time in the past or future; on no occasion; not ever
words.exampleSentence: I have never been to Paris.
words.exampleVi: Tôi chưa bao giờ đến Paris.

words.meaningEn: happening or done before the usual or expected time
words.exampleSentence: He arrived early for the meeting.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy đến sớm để họp.

words.meaningEn: doing something or taking place after the expected, proper, or usual time
words.exampleSentence: Sorry I am late.
words.exampleVi: Xin lỗi tôi đến muộn.

words.meaningEn: having a great deal to do
words.exampleSentence: I am too busy to talk right now.
words.exampleVi: Bây giờ tôi quá bận không thể nói chuyện được.
words.usageContext: Describing a state of having much work.

words.meaningEn: in a suitable state for an activity, action, or situation; fully prepared
words.exampleSentence: Are you ready to go?
words.exampleVi: Bạn đã sẵn sàng đi chưa?

words.meaningEn: confident in what one thinks or knows; having no doubt that one is right
words.exampleSentence: Are you sure about that?
words.exampleVi: Bạn có chắc về điều đó không?

words.meaningEn: take place; occur
words.exampleSentence: What will happen next?
words.exampleVi: Điều gì sẽ xảy ra tiếp theo?

words.meaningEn: have in or be able to bring to one's mind an awareness of someone or something that one has seen, known, or experienced in the past
words.exampleSentence: Do you remember me?
words.exampleVi: Bạn có nhớ tôi không?

words.meaningEn: fail to remember
words.exampleSentence: Don't forget to lock the door.
words.exampleVi: Đừng quên khóa cửa nhé.

words.meaningEn: perceive the intended meaning of words, a language, or a speaker
words.exampleSentence: I understand what you mean.
words.exampleVi: Tôi hiểu ý bạn muốn nói.

words.meaningEn: accept as true; feel sure of the truth of
words.exampleSentence: I believe you are right.
words.exampleVi: Tôi tin là bạn đúng.

words.meaningEn: come or bring to a resolution in the mind as a result of consideration
words.exampleSentence: We need to decide where to go.
words.exampleVi: Chúng ta cần quyết định xem sẽ đi đâu.

words.meaningEn: make an idea, situation, or problem clear to someone by describing it in more detail or revealing relevant facts or ideas
words.exampleSentence: Can you explain this to me?
words.exampleVi: Bạn có thể giải thích điều này cho tôi không?

words.meaningEn: have the same opinion about something
words.exampleSentence: I agree with your idea.
words.exampleVi: Tôi đồng ý với ý kiến của bạn.

words.meaningEn: have or express a different opinion
words.exampleSentence: They often disagree on politics.
words.exampleVi: Họ thường bất đồng quan điểm về chính trị.

words.meaningEn: a matter or situation regarded as unwelcome or harmful and needing to be dealt with and overcome
words.exampleSentence: We have a big problem to solve.
words.exampleVi: Chúng ta có một vấn đề lớn cần giải quyết.

words.meaningEn: a sentence worded or expressed so as to elicit information
words.exampleSentence: I have a question for you.
words.exampleVi: Tôi có một câu hỏi dành cho bạn.

words.meaningEn: as the truth or facts of a situation; really
words.exampleSentence: Actually, I don't like coffee.
words.exampleVi: Thực ra, tôi không thích cà phê.

words.meaningEn: almost certainly; as far as one knows or can tell
words.exampleSentence: It will probably rain later.
words.exampleVi: Có lẽ lát nữa trời sẽ mưa.

words.meaningEn: used as a reply to confirm or agree with what has just been said
words.exampleSentence: That is exactly what I meant.
words.exampleVi: Đó chính xác là những gì tôi muốn nói.

words.meaningEn: without doubt; used for emphasis
words.exampleSentence: I will definitely be there.
words.exampleVi: Tôi chắc chắn sẽ có mặt ở đó.

words.meaningEn: recognize the full worth of
words.exampleSentence: I really appreciate your help.
words.exampleVi: Tôi thực sự trân trọng sự giúp đỡ của bạn.

words.meaningEn: express regret for something that one has done wrong
words.exampleSentence: I must apologize for my mistake.
words.exampleVi: Tôi phải xin lỗi vì sai lầm của mình.

words.meaningEn: become fully aware of something as a fact; understand clearly
words.exampleSentence: I didn't realize how late it was.
words.exampleVi: Tôi đã không nhận ra là muộn thế nào.

words.meaningEn: identify someone or something from having encountered them before; know again
words.exampleSentence: I hardly recognized you with short hair.
words.exampleVi: Tôi gần như không nhận ra bạn với mái tóc ngắn.

words.meaningEn: make something ready for use or consideration
words.exampleSentence: She helped me prepare the dinner.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy đã giúp tôi chuẩn bị bữa tối.

words.meaningEn: put things in a neat, attractive, or required order
words.exampleSentence: We need to arrange a meeting.
words.exampleVi: Chúng ta cần sắp xếp một cuộc họp.

words.meaningEn: express dissatisfaction or annoyance about a state of affairs or an event
words.exampleSentence: He always complains about the weather.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy luôn phàn nàn về thời tiết.

words.meaningEn: give an account in words of someone or something, including all the relevant characteristics, qualities, or events
words.exampleSentence: Can you describe the man you saw?
words.exampleVi: Bạn có thể miêu tả người đàn ông bạn đã thấy không?

words.meaningEn: give support, confidence, or hope to someone
words.exampleSentence: My parents always encourage me to try my best.
words.exampleVi: Bố mẹ luôn động viên tôi cố gắng hết sức.

words.meaningEn: talk about something with another person or group of people
words.exampleSentence: Let's discuss this issue tomorrow.
words.exampleVi: Hãy thảo luận vấn đề này vào ngày mai.

words.meaningEn: able to be used or obtained; at someone's disposal
words.exampleSentence: Are you available for a call this afternoon?
words.exampleVi: Chiều nay bạn có rảnh để nghe điện thoại không?

words.meaningEn: not able to occur, exist, or be done
words.exampleSentence: It is impossible to finish this in one day.
words.exampleVi: Không thể hoàn thành việc này trong một ngày.

words.meaningEn: a set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something
words.exampleSentence: This is a great opportunity for your career.
words.exampleVi: Đây là một cơ hội tuyệt vời cho sự nghiệp của bạn.

words.meaningEn: providing physical ease and relaxation
words.exampleSentence: This chair is very comfortable.
words.exampleVi: Chiếc ghế này rất thoải mái.

words.meaningEn: practical contact with and observation of facts or events
words.exampleSentence: She has a lot of experience in marketing.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy có rất nhiều kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực marketing.

words.meaningEn: facts, information, and skills acquired by a person through experience or education
words.exampleSentence: Reading books helps expand your knowledge.
words.exampleVi: Đọc sách giúp mở rộng kiến thức của bạn.

words.meaningEn: with no qualification, restriction, or limitation; totally
words.exampleSentence: You are absolutely right.
words.exampleVi: Bạn hoàn toàn đúng.

words.meaningEn: at the present time
words.exampleSentence: I am currently working from home.
words.exampleVi: Hiện tại tôi đang làm việc ở nhà.

words.meaningEn: in the end, especially after a long delay, dispute, or series of problems
words.exampleSentence: We will eventually find a solution.
words.exampleVi: Cuối cùng thì chúng ta cũng sẽ tìm ra giải pháp.

words.meaningEn: it is fortunate that
words.exampleSentence: Fortunately, no one was hurt in the accident.
words.exampleVi: May mắn thay, không ai bị thương trong vụ tai nạn.

words.meaningEn: it is unfortunate that
words.exampleSentence: Unfortunately, I cannot attend the meeting.
words.exampleVi: Thật không may, tôi không thể tham dự cuộc họp.

words.meaningEn: in a way that is easily perceived or understood; clearly
words.exampleSentence: Obviously, this is a very important decision.
words.exampleVi: Rõ ràng, đây là một quyết định rất quan trọng.

words.meaningEn: so as to give special emphasis to a point; specifically
words.exampleSentence: I particularly enjoyed the dessert.
words.exampleVi: Tôi đặc biệt thích món tráng miệng.

words.meaningEn: in a sufficiently great or important way as to be worthy of attention
words.exampleSentence: Profits have increased significantly this year.
words.exampleVi: Lợi nhuận đã tăng đáng kể trong năm nay.

words.meaningEn: as far as one knows or can see
words.exampleSentence: Apparently, the store is closed today.
words.exampleVi: Hình như cửa hàng đóng cửa hôm nay.

words.meaningEn: finally; in the end
words.exampleSentence: Ultimately, it is your decision to make.
words.exampleVi: Cuối cùng thì đó là quyết định của bạn.

words.meaningEn: carry out a systematic or formal inquiry to discover and examine the facts of an incident, allegation, etc., so as to establish the truth
words.exampleSentence: The police will investigate the crime scene.
words.exampleVi: Cảnh sát sẽ điều tra hiện trường vụ án.

words.meaningEn: try to reach an agreement or compromise by discussion with others
words.exampleSentence: They had to negotiate the terms of the contract.
words.exampleVi: Họ đã phải thương lượng các điều khoản của hợp đồng.

words.meaningEn: cause someone to do something through reasoning or argument
words.exampleSentence: I tried to persuade him to join us.
words.exampleVi: Tôi đã cố gắng thuyết phục anh ấy tham gia cùng chúng tôi.

words.meaningEn: put forward with approval as being suitable for a particular purpose or role
words.exampleSentence: Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby?
words.exampleVi: Bạn có thể giới thiệu một nhà hàng ngon gần đây không?

words.meaningEn: need for a particular purpose
words.exampleSentence: This job requires a lot of patience.
words.exampleVi: Công việc này đòi hỏi rất nhiều sự kiên nhẫn.

words.meaningEn: examine methodically and in detail the constitution or structure of something
words.exampleSentence: We need to analyze the data carefully.
words.exampleVi: Chúng ta cần phân tích dữ liệu một cách cẩn thận.

words.meaningEn: form an idea of the amount, number, or value of; assess
words.exampleSentence: The teacher will evaluate your performance.
words.exampleVi: Giáo viên sẽ đánh giá hiệu suất của bạn.

words.meaningEn: establish or indicate who or what someone or something is
words.exampleSentence: Can you identify the man in this photo?
words.exampleVi: Bạn có thể nhận ra người đàn ông trong bức ảnh này không?

words.meaningEn: show or prove to be right or reasonable
words.exampleSentence: How can you justify your actions?
words.exampleVi: Làm sao bạn có thể biện minh cho hành động của mình?

words.meaningEn: say or estimate that a specified thing will happen in the future or will be a consequence of something
words.exampleSentence: It is hard to predict the weather accurately.
words.exampleVi: Rất khó để dự đoán thời tiết chính xác.

words.meaningEn: present, appearing, or found everywhere
words.exampleSentence: Mobile phones have become ubiquitous in modern society.
words.exampleVi: Điện thoại di động đã trở nên phổ biến ở khắp nơi trong xã hội hiện đại.

words.meaningEn: open to more than one interpretation; having a double meaning
words.exampleSentence: His reply to my question was somewhat ambiguous.
words.exampleVi: Câu trả lời của anh ấy cho câu hỏi của tôi có phần mơ hồ.

words.meaningEn: showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise
words.exampleSentence: She is very meticulous about her appearance.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy rất tỉ mỉ về vẻ bề ngoài của mình.

words.meaningEn: existing or occurring at or on the surface
words.exampleSentence: The book only gives a superficial understanding of the topic.
words.exampleVi: Cuốn sách chỉ mang lại sự hiểu biết hời hợt về chủ đề này.

words.meaningEn: logical and consistent
words.exampleSentence: He presented a coherent argument for the new policy.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy đã trình bày một lập luận mạch lạc cho chính sách mới.

words.meaningEn: certain to happen; unavoidable
words.exampleSentence: Change is an inevitable part of life.
words.exampleVi: Thay đổi là một phần không thể tránh khỏi của cuộc sống.

words.meaningEn: not or no longer needed or useful; superfluous
words.exampleSentence: The new technology has made old methods redundant.
words.exampleVi: Công nghệ mới đã làm cho các phương pháp cũ trở nên thừa thãi.

words.meaningEn: able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities
words.exampleSentence: He is a highly versatile actor who can play any role.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy là một diễn viên rất đa năng, có thể đóng mọi vai trò.

words.meaningEn: producing a great deal of profit
words.exampleSentence: She has a lucrative business in real estate.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy có một công việc kinh doanh béo bở trong lĩnh vực bất động sản.

words.meaningEn: dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations
words.exampleSentence: We need to take a pragmatic approach to solving this issue.
words.exampleVi: Chúng ta cần áp dụng một cách tiếp cận thực tế để giải quyết vấn đề này.

words.meaningEn: examine or inspect closely and thoroughly
words.exampleSentence: The committee will scrutinize the proposal before making a decision.
words.exampleVi: Ủy ban sẽ xem xét kỹ lưỡng đề xuất trước khi đưa ra quyết định.

words.meaningEn: make suffering, deficiency, or a problem less severe
words.exampleSentence: The medicine will help alleviate the pain.
words.exampleVi: Thuốc sẽ giúp làm giảm cơn đau.

words.meaningEn: make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse
words.exampleSentence: His comments only served to exacerbate the situation.
words.exampleVi: Những bình luận của anh ấy chỉ làm tình hình trở nên trầm trọng hơn.

words.meaningEn: make something physically stronger or more solid
words.exampleSentence: The two companies will consolidate to form a stronger corporation.
words.exampleVi: Hai công ty sẽ hợp nhất để tạo thành một tập đoàn mạnh mẽ hơn.

words.meaningEn: rise and fall irregularly in number or amount
words.exampleSentence: The price of gold tends to fluctuate depending on the market.
words.exampleVi: Giá vàng có xu hướng biến động tùy thuộc vào thị trường.

words.meaningEn: make less severe, serious, or painful
words.exampleSentence: We need to plant more trees to mitigate the effects of climate change.
words.exampleVi: Chúng ta cần trồng nhiều cây hơn để giảm nhẹ tác động của biến đổi khí hậu.

words.meaningEn: make an action or process easy or easier
words.meaningVi: tạo điều kiện, làm cho dễ dàng
words.exampleSentence: The new software will facilitate the workflow for our team.
words.exampleVi: Phần mềm mới sẽ tạo điều kiện thuận lợi cho quy trình làm việc của nhóm chúng ta.

words.meaningEn: a person who publicly supports or recommends a particular cause or policy
words.exampleSentence: She is a strong advocate for animal rights.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy là một người ủng hộ mạnh mẽ cho quyền động vật.

words.meaningEn: put a decision, plan, agreement, etc. into effect
words.exampleSentence: The government plans to implement the new policy next year.
words.exampleVi: Chính phủ có kế hoạch thực hiện chính sách mới vào năm tới.

words.meaningEn: find something out for certain; make sure of
words.exampleSentence: We need to ascertain the cause of the problem before fixing it.
words.exampleVi: Chúng ta cần xác minh nguyên nhân của vấn đề trước khi khắc phục nó.
